## Figure 2.6: Foreign Exchange Accumulation in Low- and Middle-Income Countries, 2026
Line chart.

- **Y-axis:** Percent change from a year earlier
  - **Range:** -2 to 8
- **X-axis:** Months in 2026
  - **Jan, Feb, Mar, Apr, May, Jun**
- **Series / legend:**
  - **Commodity exporters** (dark solid line)
  - **Commodity importers** (light solid line)
  - **Commodity importers (excl. China)** (light dotted line)
- **Time span:** January to June 2026

### Approximate values from line positions
| Month | Commodity exporters | Commodity importers | Commodity importers (excl. China) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Jan | ≈6.0 | ≈6.3 | ≈7.1 |
| Feb | ≈6.5 | ≈6.2 | ≈6.3 |
| Mar | ≈4.0 | ≈2.5 | ≈1.0 |
| Apr | ≈2.3 | ≈3.2 | ≈1.5 |
| May | ≈3.2 | ≈3.4 | ≈0.4 |
| Jun | ≈4.3 | ≈2.0 | ≈-0.2 |

### Visual comparisons and trends
- **Highest value in the figure:** Commodity importers (excl. China) in **January**, at about **7.1 percent**.
- **Lowest value in the figure:** Commodity importers (excl. China) in **June**, slightly **negative** at about **-0.2 percent**.
- **Commodity exporters**:
  - Rise slightly from **January to February**.
  - Fall sharply through **March and April**.
  - Recover in **May and June**.
  - End **June** as the **highest** of the three series.
- **Commodity importers**:
  - Stay a little above **6 percent** in **January-February**.
  - Drop steeply in **March**.
  - Recover modestly in **April-May**.
  - Decline again in **June**.
- **Commodity importers (excl. China)**:
  - Start highest in **January**.
  - Decline continuously overall, with only a small uptick in **April**.
  - Approach **zero** in **May** and turn **slightly negative** in **June**.
- **Ranking by month**:
  - **January:** Importers excl. China > Importers > Exporters
  - **February:** Exporters > Importers excl. China > Importers
  - **March:** Exporters > Importers > Importers excl. China
  - **April:** Importers > Exporters > Importers excl. China
  - **May:** Importers > Exporters > Importers excl. China
  - **June:** Exporters > Importers > Importers excl. China
- The **commodity exporters** and **commodity importers** series cross between **March and April**, with importers moving above exporters in **April-May**, before exporters move back above importers in **June**.

**Sources:** Original calculations based on data from Haver Analytics; International Monetary Fund; World Bank Group.

**Note:** Figure shows year-on-year changes in foreign exchange in US dollars. Aggregates are computed as weighted averages. Sample includes up to 40 commodity exporters and 34 commodity importers.
